purpose: Persist lane-level liveness, repeated blocker fingerprints, and observed promotion flow time without turning lane blockers into project-wide stalls.

rules.first_blocked_run: PARKED_FOR_RETRY lane only, then rotate to another eligible lane
rules.second_consecutive_identical_blocker: P1 ORCHESTRATION_DEFECT requiring changed execution strategy or control-plane/process repair
rules.project_wide_parking: forbidden while any parallel-safe eligible lane exists
rules.flow_time: measure only from explicit observed promotion transition timestamps; UNKNOWN is never coerced to zero

forbidden: converting missing flow evidence to zero
using watchdog state as merge authority
letting orchestrator maintenance displace executable product P0-P5 work
